raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 contains a replay of 378 transactions (every txn_id appears twice, 5244 rows vs 4866 distinct ids). The replayed copies, ingested at 05:00, carry txn_ts as epoch milliseconds (e.g. 1768716186000 = 2026-01-18 06:03:06 UTC), which the TIMESTAMP cast rejects. The fix is to parse epoch-ms timestamps and keep one row per txn_id, preferring the earliest ingest, before the POSTED filter.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, txn_ts_parsed AS txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts_parsed AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, status, COALESCE(TRY_CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP), epoch_ms(TRY_CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT))) AS txn_ts_parsed FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts, batch_id) = 1) WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
